headline: March 2020’s lesson for dollar funding: watch propagation, not prediction
dek: The dash for cash showed how an external shock can turn demand for dollars into a balance-sheet and market-liquidity problem. Today’s tape did not clear the full-story gate.

headline: What the April 2025 basis unwind teaches about dollar-funding capacity
dek: This historical replay separates a calendar-and-balance-sheet warning from an observed funding break. Today’s tape did not clear the full-story gate: overnight cash still signals abundance.

headline: Reserve drain puts the calendar in charge of dollar-funding risk
dek: A measured reserve decline and a dated settlement have put Seiche’s funding board in STRAIN. But overnight cash still signals abundance, making the settlement a test of whether calendar pressure can become a funding constraint.
